new_value: June 10, 2026: AWS Graviton5 (3nm, 192-core, +25% vs Graviton4) GA in EC2 M9g/M9gd, purpose-built for agentic-AI CPU inference; Meta deploying 'tens of millions' of cores, Uber + Snowflake onboard.
headline: AWS lands first-party agentic-AI silicon: Graviton5 GA with Meta/Uber/Snowflake validation
so_what: Blunts our 'AWS rents its AI soul / Google owns the whole stack' line on the CPU-inference layer where agentic workloads now run. Reps must stop claiming AWS has no first-party agentic-inference silicon. Reframe Google's edge specifically to AI accelerators/TPU (training + matrix compute) vs CPU, and note Graviton5 has external hyperscaler validation (Meta tens-of-millions of cores) the way we cite Blackstone/TPU demand.

new_value: AWS shipped a production-agent stack at Summit NYC (June 17, 2026): AgentCore harness GA, managed Knowledge Base, native Web Search grounding, agent observability/A-B testing, WAF AI-bot monetization, plus previews of AWS Context (agent knowledge graph) and AWS Continuum (agentic security).
headline: AWS ships production-agent platform at Summit NYC, contesting Google's Vertex and Gemini Enterprise Agent edge
so_what: Reps can no longer position Bedrock as proof-of-concept-only against a more mature Google agent platform. Stop leaning on agent-platform maturity as a clean Vertex/Gemini win, and shift the contrast to where Google still holds: TPU inference economics and single-stack model ownership. Flag that AWS Context and Continuum are previews, not GA, when a buyer cites them.

old_value: Tracked AWS/Amazon capex was global only: Amazon guided to roughly $200B in 2026 capex, with no India-specific commitment tracked.
new_value: Amazon added $13B for India AI/cloud through 2030, lifting its 2026-2030 India AI/cloud plan above $21B and total five-year India commitment to $48B, expanding AWS capacity in Mumbai and Hyderabad with Trainium and Bedrock.
headline: AWS commits an extra $13B to India AI/cloud capacity through 2030
so_what: In India deals, AWS can now answer capacity doubts with a fresh local-capacity commitment in Mumbai and Hyderabad. A Google rep leaning on AWS supply constraints should expect that counter and reframe to Google's own $15B Andhra Pradesh AI hub rather than concede regional capacity.
